scheduled.title: Delta LAX to Vancouver from Nov 21
scheduled.detail: Twice daily on the A319, per Cirium data as reported. Delta also lists West Palm Beach (Nov 23) from LAX.

news.title: SAN saw nearly 200 volume delays Thursday afternoon
news.detail: CBS 8 reports an FAA traffic management program at San Diego International on Nov 5, with delays averaging 38 minutes. As of 5:14 p.m., the airport had 187 delays (70 departures, 117 arrivals).

news.title: Air France to start nonstop San Diego to Paris May 3, 2027
news.detail: Three weekly Airbus A350 flights (Mon, Wed, Fri): AF059 leaves SAN at 3:10 p.m. for CDG, return AF058. Paris becomes SAN's first nonstop to France and its 90th nonstop destination, per the Nov 4 report citing the airport and Air France October announcement.

news.title: LAX south-terminal taxiways stay closed through Nov 20
news.detail: LAWA's STTR Phases 3/3B keep Taxiway B between C7 and C10, Taxiways B6 and B7 between Runway 25R and Taxiway B, and Taxiways C8 and C9 between B and C closed continuously through Nov 20, 2026.

news.title: LAX runway 7R/25L closed overnight Nov 9 through Nov 13 morning
news.detail: An FAA NOTAM closes Runway 07R/25L daily from 12:30 a.m. to 6:30 a.m. Pacific, Nov 9 through the morning of Nov 13.

news.title: LAX runway 7L/25R closes overnight again Sat Nov 7 into Sunday morning
news.detail: An FAA NOTAM closes Runway 07L/25R daily from 1:00 a.m. to 6:30 a.m. Pacific, Nov 7 through the morning of Nov 8.

news.title: Future Travel Experience covers Hollywood Burbank's new terminal
news.detail: The Nov 2026 feature notes valet and rideshare next to the building, an airfield-view bar, local art, outdoor boarding kept, and more runway separation plus current earthquake and ADA standards ahead of LA28.

news.title: John Wayne Airport closed overnight through Sunday morning
news.detail: An FAA NOTAM closes SNA daily from 11:30 p.m. to 6:15 a.m. Pacific, through the morning of Nov 8 (0730-1415 UTC).

news.title: Burbank's digital ramp control is now fully operational
news.detail: Searidge says its camera-based Virtual Ramp Control Room went live with BUR's new terminal on Oct 13, giving ramp controllers a real-time view of ramp and gate areas plus their own ADS-B ground feed.

news.title: ENR: LAWA letter cites 252-day people mover delay
news.detail: An Oct 26 LAWA letter cites a 252-day delay from the lenders' technical advisor and says the opening date remains TBD until LINXS fixes outstanding safety and structural items.

news.title: LAX Terminal 2 arrivals shuttle stops closed Nov 1 to 7
news.detail: LAX shuttle, LAX-it and FlyAway stops at Terminal 2 arrivals are closed; use the stops at Terminals 1 or 3. Terminal 2 inner-lane work moves to the median islands on Nov 4.

news.title: LAX Taxilane D9 resurfacing brings nightly closures through Nov 11
news.detail: Taxiway D between Terminals 2 and 3 and Taxilane D9 close nightly from midnight to 5:30 a.m. while the eastern part of D9 is resurfaced, with the project ending Nov 11 at 6 a.m. LAWA says aircraft tow operations are expected to increase.

news.title: Airport Newswire: Burbank's new terminal was built alongside live operations
news.detail: The airport authority says the new terminal adds more separation from the runways, meets current earthquake and ADA standards, and keeps outdoor boarding.

news.title: LAX says contractor has not finished required people mover testing
news.detail: Responding to the contractor's Feb 5, 2027 forecast, LAX officials blamed LINXS for failing to complete the required system demonstration testing.

news.title: San Diego health officer acts on Montgomery-Gibbs lead pollution
news.detail: inewsource reports only 168 gallons of unleaded UL 94 have sold at MYF in two years versus nearly 1.5 million gallons of leaded fuel. County Public Health Officer Sayone Thihalolipavan has alerted area pediatricians and is exploring help for pilots to certify planes for unleaded fuel.

news.title: LA Times: LAX people mover now not expected before February 2027
news.detail: The contractor says the 2.25-mile Skylink train won't open until at least February 2027, citing unsigned agreements between the airport and DWP. City officials declined to discuss the delay.

news.title: ABC7 airs video of apparent explosion during LAX people mover testing
news.detail: ABC7 reports documents citing three arc blast incidents on Sept. 23 and a fourth on Sept. 25. LAWA confirms an arc flash but says it cannot confirm the video's source. LAWA says repairs are done and testing has resumed; the earliest public opening is early next year.

news.title: Video shows arc flash during LAX people mover test
news.detail: FOX 11 aired video from late September of an arc flash on the guideway just after a test train passed. LAWA says repairs are complete, and contractor LINXS says System Demonstration Testing has restarted. No passenger service date is confirmed.

news.title: Ontario Airport shuttles now trackable in real time
news.detail: Passengers can scan a QR code at ONT shuttle stops to see a live map and arrival times. The airport says four electric shuttles will replace the leased fleet.

news.title: LAX Terminal 6 arrivals curbside shuttle stops closed this week
news.detail: LAX shuttle, LAX-it and FlyAway stops at Terminal 6 arrivals are closed; use Terminal 7, per the airport's Nov 1 to 7 construction alert.

news.title: LAX people mover hit by guideway damage; contractor now forecasts Feb 5, 2027
news.detail: A project report says three blast incidents in late September damaged the power rail and guide beam. The guide beam is repaired; power-rail work has no confirmed timeline. LINXS projects passenger service could begin Feb 5, 2027, a contractor forecast, not a LAWA date.

news.title: Why San Diego flights keep running late
news.detail: NBC 7 reports rising delays at SAN, the busiest single-runway airport in the country, citing FAA volume delays, airline scheduling banks, weather and the FAA's $12.5 billion air traffic control overhaul.

news.title: Palm Springs Airport broke ground Oct 20 on $94 million baggage system
news.detail: PSP says the new baggage handling system will triple processing capacity, since the current one handles only about half the bags the airport needs. Completion is expected in late 2028.

news.title: Delta pauses JFK to John Wayne after Nov 29
news.detail: Delta's last New York JFK to Orange County flights run Nov 29, with daily service set to return May 6, 2027 on the same flight numbers and times, per Cirium data as reported. American keeps its daily JFK to SNA flights.

news.title: Report: Montgomery-Gibbs is the nation's top airport lead polluter
news.detail: An inewsource investigation published Oct 18 says the San Diego general aviation airport, where many piston planes still burn leaded fuel, emits the most lead of any U.S. airport and its traffic passes about 30 schools.

news.title: Menzies Aviation files to lay off 137 at LAX effective Nov 19
news.detail: A California WARN Act notice lists 137 permanent layoffs at the ground handler's LAX operation. The filing does not say which roles are affected.

news.title: New Hollywood Burbank terminal is open
news.detail: The $1.3 billion, 14-gate terminal opened Tuesday, Oct 13, on the opposite side of the airfield. The main entrance moved to Winona Avenue and Hollywood Way, Lot E closed, and rideshare pickup moved to a new lot near the terminal.

news.title: American tests snack pre-orders on DFW to LAX from Oct 20
news.detail: Travelers on Dallas Fort Worth to LAX flights can reserve buy-on-board food items in the app or online from seven days to 20 hours before departure.

news.title: Alaska adds San Diego to Loreto from Dec 19
news.detail: Twice weekly (Wed, Sat) on SkyWest-operated Embraer 175s through April 28, 2027. Alaska says it is the airline's 50th nonstop from SAN.

news.title: Delta adds LAX to Monterey Dec 19 and LAX to Philadelphia June 7, 2027
news.detail: Monterey is twice daily on Delta Connection Embraer 175s. Philadelphia is daily on an Airbus A321neo. Delta also adds frequencies to Boston, Raleigh-Durham, San Diego and others in 2027.

news.title: Delta ends Las Vegas to San Diego on Nov 8
news.detail: Last LAS-SAN flight is Nov 8, 2026. Delta is dropping both Southern California flights from Las Vegas this winter, citing lower winter demand.

events.title: No military jet demo teams scheduled in SoCal today
events.detail: The FAA notice of 2026 military demo-team airshows shows the nearby SoCal dates, Miramar (Sep 25 to 27) and Huntington Beach (Oct 2 to 4), are done for the year.
events.source: FAA Domestic Notice, 2026 military aerial demonstration airshows

events.title: Wings 'N' Wheels at Minter Field, Shafter, Sat Nov 7
events.detail: The 9th annual aircraft and car show at Minter Field Air Museum, 201 Aviation St, Shafter. Spectator gates open at 9 a.m.

events.title: Flabob Airport Veterans Celebration, Sat Nov 14
events.detail: 24th annual, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Flabob Airport in Jurupa Valley. Free admission with vintage aircraft, a noon honor ceremony and a car show. Airplane rides cost extra.

events.title: P-38J Lightning flight and Hangar Talk, Planes of Fame, Chino, Sat Nov 7
events.detail: Doors open 9 a.m., Hangar Talk 10:30 a.m. to noon, P-38J engine start and flight at 12:15 p.m., plus the Ed Maloney Scale Model Contest. Regular admission applies.

audio.transcript:
Good morning, SoCal. This is the Aircraft Aviation daily brief for Friday, November 6. You are hearing a narrated test voice, not Ben.

Our 6:18 AM PT, 6:28 AM PT, 6:38 AM PT snapshot caught 204 aircraft over Southern California. Heavy metal: UPS Boeing 747-8 N609UP, on the ground at ONT. Heavy metal: Delta Boeing 767-400 N827MH, on the ground at LAX. Military: EC45 13-72304, over SoCal at 5,450 ft, nearest airport SAN. Widebody at LGB: United Boeing 787-9 N38950, low near LGB (4,875 ft).

No military jet demo teams scheduled in SoCal today.

In the news: SAN saw nearly 200 volume delays Thursday afternoon.

That's the board. Clear skies, and happy spotting.
